known_limits: No real CPE/router or public-WAN vantage: traversal capability remains real-daemon netns lab evidence (miniupnpd 2.3.4 + coturn), not industry-hardware evidence.
Windows/darwin are cross-build compile evidence only; the STUN shared-port gate (StunSharedPortSupported) fails closed at runtime on non-Linux.

D5 residual stale-window: a trailing OnMapping* lifecycle event that lands after its forward was replaced can satisfy the mapped guard when the replacement forward is also live and mapping-capable (the library has no per-acquisition callback token).
The detection profile periodic job (Detector.Run) is opt-in via Config.DetectionInterval (default 0); P15 owns surfacing the operator control for the autonomous schedule.

The durable applied record's MappingJournalRef is refreshed only when reconcile applies a newer revision; recovery attaches the NEW journal ref through OnApplied and classifies the old record as superseded, but same-revision LKG refresh of the applied bucket remains P14's evacuation/ownership scope.

Pre-existing timing-sensitive internal/agent receipt test (TestPeriodicReceiptRetrySameSessionAfterChallengeNotEstablished) can time out under full parallel race load; it passes when re-run in isolation and is unrelated to P12W (observed once in the S8 commit run, cleared on re-run).
